A Windows desktop application bringing together signals, alerts, a trading journal, results tracking, and risk/capital-management tools. It does not place trades or receive your funds; you decide and trade in your broker account.
Telegram Premium and the panel: what changes?

Regular Premium starts at USD200 in your own trading account and keeps its existing benefits and channels. For new members, Premium + Panel starts at USD230 in one Exnova, Binomo or Stockity account. I first validate your broker ID; you can then deposit into your own trading account, and I enable panel access once I validate the deposit. It is an additional Premium benefit, not a separate community tier. The USD230 stays in your trading account and does not pay for the panel license.

Exnova signals are delivered exclusively in the panel, never through Telegram. Sunday Advance Premium Software lists of currency pairs and Crypto IDX for Binomo and Stockity are also panel-only. The usual Monday–Saturday Telegram deliveries continue unchanged. The panel also lets you keep a personal journal and track your results.

The initial trial lasts 14 days and enables all three brokers. It begins with the first approval of panel access; reinstalling or validating another broker does not restart it. Your registration broker does not restrict your later license choice, and you do not need a USD230 deposit at each broker.

Exnova only: USD15/month or COP50,000. Exnova + Binomo + Stockity: USD20/month or COP65,000. Choose your plan when paying; all three are optional. Your trading deposit is separate from this monthly license.

There are 3 grace days after expiry. Afterwards the signals interface is locked and only offers access to the payment portal; your history is preserved. When applicable, reconnection adds USD8: Exnova total USD23 / COP76,000; all three USD28 / COP92,500. Overdue monthly fees do not accumulate.

Register using the official bot links. I first validate your ID; you can then make the deposit into your own trading account. Only after I also validate the deposit and your applicable panel access condition is met does the bot deliver the download access, image and installation manual. Your panel account requires my approval. This page is informational: reading it does not activate a license or provide credentials. The application runs on Windows computers, not phones or Mac.

Return to the registration bot and use its registration options or contact me. If you already have Premium with USD200, ask about validating the additional USD30 in the same account to qualify for the panel benefit. Signals do not guarantee results; apply your risk management.

If you were already Premium or Prestige before launch, you can add the panel with a NEW deposit of at least USD100 made on or after 11 November 2026 into your own trading account. Notify me with the proof so I can validate the date and deposit; earlier deposits do not count. Basic members must upgrade to Premium + Panel up to USD230 within the existing accumulation rules/window, or make a new USD230 deposit if accumulation no longer applies. I first validate the ID, and the deposit must be made afterwards. Your usual Telegram benefits continue.
